question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in Germany, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Germany has no complete national register of solar PV projects in permitting. Bundesnetzagentur's Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) publishes 63,257 solar units in status 'In Planung' (1,094 ground-mounted), with kWp/kW capacity and WGS84 coordinates above 30 kW, but pre-commissioning registration is voluntary for solar PV under § 5(4) MaStRV and merges planning, permitting and construction into one status. Bundesnetzagentur's EEG tender XLSX files add awarded kW, bidder, parcel location and award date for subsidised projects. Binding zoning stages (Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegung, Satzungsbeschluss) sit as PDFs across 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals and ~11,000 municipalities.
main_caveats: Under § 5(4) MaStRV, pre-commissioning MaStR registration ('In Planung') is mandatory only for federal-law permits (e.g. BImSchG, WHG); standard solar PV is registered voluntarily until 1 month after commissioning.

MaStR has only one pre-commissioning status ('In Planung', code 31), lumping early concepts together with projects that already hold a Satzungsbeschluss, Baugenehmigung or are actively under construction ('Im Bau').
Large solar parks are often split across multiple MaStR units (e.g. PVA Schafhöfen Anlagenteil 1 at 17.6 MWp and Anlagenteil 2 at 200 MWp vs 268 MWp grid reservation in the municipal Bebauungsplan).
MaStR redacts coordinates, street and Flurstück for solar units <=30 kW (58,539 of 63,257 planned units) and masks natural-person operators under § 15(1) MaStRV.

BNetzA EEG tender lists cover only awarded subsidised bids (excluding subsidy-free PPA parks and pre-tender projects), omit coordinates, and split multi-Gemarkung bids across rows in Zuschläge_Detailliert.
Privileged ground-mounted PV within 200 m of motorways or double-track railways (§ 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB) and rooftop PV skip Bebauungspläne; county Baugenehmigungen are not publicly listed.
answer.confidence_reason: Statutory inclusion/privacy rules (§§ 5, 15 MaStRV; §§ 35, 37 EEG; § 10a BauGB), live MaStR API/bulk exports, BNetzA tender XLSX files, all 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals, UVP-Verbund, GEM and OSM were directly tested.

attributes.note: MaStR gives WGS84 coordinates and parcels for voluntary 'In Planung' units >30 kW (municipality/PLZ <=30 kW); BNetzA XLSX gives Gemarkung/Flurstück for EEG tender winners.
attributes.gap_note: Pre-commissioning MaStR registration is voluntary for solar PV (§ 5(4) MaStRV) and withholds coordinates/parcels at <=30 kW (§ 15(1) MaStRV). Privileged § 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB building permits are not published; ~11,000 municipal Bauleitplanung portals behind the 16 tested Länder portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: MaStR publishes DC Bruttoleistung (kWp), AC Nettonennleistung (kW) and inverter kW; BNetzA XLSX publishes awarded Gebotsmenge (kW) per winning EEG bid.
attributes.gap_note: Projects not yet voluntarily entered in MaStR or awarded an EEG tender have no national structured MW record. Municipal Bebauungspläne legally fix Sondergebiet area (ha) and height, stating MWp/grid reservation only variably in PDF Begründungen across ~11,000 municipalities (sampled).

attributes.note: BNetzA EEG award lists publish Name des Bieters; vorhabenbezogene Bebauungspläne (§ 12 BauGB) name the Vorhabenträger; MaStR publishes Anlagenbetreiber (non-natural persons).
attributes.gap_note: MaStR's Anlagenbetreiber field does not distinguish whether the registrant is the Projektierer (developer) or future operator, and masks natural persons (243 of 1,094 planned ground-mounted units). Non-project-specific Angebotsbebauungspläne often omit developers, and municipal portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: Länder/municipal Bauleitplanung PDFs distinguish Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegung and Satzungsbeschluss; BNetzA certifies EEG Zuschlag; MaStR only shows generic 'In Planung'.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR merges early planning, zoning, permitted and under-construction ('Im Bau') solar units into a single 'In Planung' status (1,014 of 1,094 ground-mounted units have no permit record). State/county Baugenehmigungen and construction start are not published online, and ~11,000 municipal portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: BNetzA XLSX gives legal award notice date (Bekanntgabe des Zuschlags); municipal B-Plan PDFs give council decision dates; MaStR gives registration and planned COD dates only.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR exposes EinheitRegistrierungsdatum and GeplantesInbetriebnahmedatum in JSON, while permit decision dates in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml are absent for 92.7% of planned ground-mounted units. Baugenehmigung dates are not published, and municipal Bauleitplanung notices across ~11,000 municipalities were only sampled.

sources.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) — Öffentliche Einheitenübersicht & Gesamtdatenexport
sources.format: JSON API, CSV export, and daily bulk XML (ZIP)
sources.adds: Primary national structured dataset of voluntarily registered pre-commissioning ('In Planung') solar PV units with kWp/kW capacities, operator/registrant, planned commissioning date, and WGS84 coordinates + Flurstücke above 30 kW.
sources.summary: Official federal energy register exposing voluntarily registered 'In Planung' solar PV units via a filterable JSON API, CSV export and a daily 3.31 GB XML archive (Gesamtdatenexport).
sources.coverage_note: 63,257 individual solar PV units in status 'In Planung' on 2026-11-25: 1,094 Freiflächensolaranlagen (across 1,053 park names), 45,008 Gebäudesolaranlagen, 17,135 Balkonkraftwerke and 20 Sonstige; 4,718 units exceed 30 kW (with coordinates) and 850 exceed 1 MWp.
caveats: Voluntary pre-commissioning for standard solar PV (§ 5(4) MaStRV); omits un-registered permitting pipelines.
Single 'In Planung' status does not separate zoning, building permit or active construction; multi-unit parks split across rows.
Coordinates/parcels withheld at <=30 kW and natural-person operators masked (§ 15(1) MaStRV).

unit.value: Bruttoleistung in kWp (DC module peak), Nettonennleistung in kW (AC), and ZugeordneteWirkleistungWechselrichter in kW (inverter active power); divide by 1,000 for MWp/MW.
unit.quote: Bruttoleistung: 200.000 kWp / Nettonennleistung (Wert wird vom System ausgefüllt): 200.000 kW / Zugeordnete Wechselrichterleistung: 200.000 kW

inclusion_rule.value: Mandatory within 1 month after commissioning for all grid-connected stationary solar PV units (§ 5(1), (5) MaStRV). Pre-commissioning registration in status 'In Planung' is mandatory only if a federal-law permit (BImSchG, WindSeeG, WHG or other Bundesrecht) is required and granted (§ 5(4) MaStRV); for standard BauGB/Landesbauordnung solar PV it is voluntary.
inclusion_rule.quote: Betreiber müssen ihre Projekte im Marktstammdatenregister gemäß Absatz 5 registrieren, wenn die Errichtung oder der Betrieb der Stromerzeugungseinheit einer Zulassung nach dem Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz, dem Windenergie-auf-See-Gesetz oder sonstigem Bundesrecht bedarf und die Zulassung erteilt wurde.

reference_date.value: Live JSON API queried on 2026-11-25; daily bulk XML archive Gesamtdatenexport_20261125_26.2.zip updated 2026-11-25 00:00:00 (with quarterly Stichtag snapshots retained since 2023-04-01).
reference_date.quote: Gesamtdatenauszug vom Vortag Download Daten [ZIP / 3.233.608 KB] Beschreibung des Exports [ZIP / 1.372 KB] Typ: XML Letzte Aktualisierung: 25.11.2026 00:00:00

update_frequency.value: Continuous live updates in the web/JSON API; bulk XML Gesamtdatenexport regenerated daily around 05:00 CET.
update_frequency.quote: Der Datendownload wird in der Regel um 5:00 Uhr auf den zu diesem Zeitpunkt gültigen Datenstand aktualisiert.

exclusions.value: Off-grid units without direct/indirect grid connection and military national-defence units are exempt (§ 5(2) MaStRV). Under § 15(1) MaStRV, street, house number, Flurstück and coordinates are withheld for units <=30 kW, and personal data of natural-person operators are withheld.
exclusions.quote: Standortangaben zu Straße, Hausnummer, Flurstücksbezeichnungen und Geokoordinaten von Erzeugungseinheiten nach der Anlage Tabelle B bis E mit einer Leistung von höchstens 30 Kilowatt, wobei auf zu Solaranlagen gehörende Einheiten § 5 Absatz 1 Satz 2 anzuwenden ist

key_fields.meaning: Unique MaStR generator unit identifier (prefix SEE...); links to EegAnlageMastrNummer (EEG...) and SolarparkName.
Operational status: 31 = 'In Planung' (single pre-commissioning bucket covering planning, permitting and construction), 35 = 'In Betrieb'.
Solar category: 852 = Freiflächensolaranlage, 853 = Gebäudesolaranlage, 2484 = Sonstige Solaranlage, 2961 = Steckerfertige Solaranlage.

DC module peak capacity in kWp, AC net nominal capacity in kW, and assigned inverter active power in kW (latter in detail view and EinheitenSolar.xml); grid connection capacity is not a separate MaStR field.
Registered operator or project developer ('vom künftigen Betreiber oder vom Projektierer'); masked as 'natürliche Person' for individuals.
WGS84 latitude/longitude and cadastral parcel text, published only when unit Bruttoleistung exceeds 30 kW and IsAnonymisiert is false.
MaStR registration date and self-reported target commissioning date (/Date(ms)/ in JSON); permit dates in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml exist only for 80 of 1,094 planned ground-mounted units.

KG","BetriebsStatusName":"In Planung","Bundesland":"Bayern","Gemeinde":"Mötzing","Gemarkung":"Haimbuch","Breitengrad":48.887633,"Laengengrad":12.421482,"Bruttoleistung":200000.0,"Nettonennleistung":200000.0}]}
steps: Query GetErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung with URL-encoded Kendo filter Betriebs-Status~eq~'31'~and~Energieträger~eq~'2495' (all 63,257 planned solar PV units) and add ~and~Art der Solaranlage~eq~'852' for ground-mounted parks (1,094 units) or ~and~Bruttoleistung der Einheit~gt~'30' for >30 kW units with coordinates (4,718 units; 850 >1,000 kW).

Paginate with page and pageSize (tested up to pageSize=1200 in a single JSON call), convert Bruttoleistung (kWp) and Nettonennleistung (kW) to MWp/MW by dividing by 1,000, and decode /Date(epoch_ms)/ timestamps.

For full offline analysis including inverter kW (ZugeordneteWirkleistungWechselrichter), land area (GroesseDerInAnspruchGenommenenFlaecheInHektar) and rare permit records, download https://download.marktstammdatenregister.de/Gesamtdatenexport_YYYYMMDD_26.2.zip (3.31 GB, 450 XML shards) and join EinheitenSolar_*.xml (EinheitBetriebsstatus=31) to AnlagenEegSolar_*.xml and EinheitenGenehmigung_*.xml.
reading_traps: Filter field names in GetErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung must match GetFilterColumnsErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung exactly (e.g. 'Bruttoleistung der Einheit', not 'Bruttoleistung'); unrecognized filter names are silently ignored and return the unfiltered 63,257 count.

Each record is a generator unit (Einheit), not necessarily a whole project: the 1,094 planned Freiflächensolaranlage units map to 1,053 distinct SolarparkName/unit entries (e.g. Solarpark Schafhöfen is split into SEE991008057236 at 17,600 kWp and SEE963914434579 at 200,000 kWp).

1,014 of 1,094 planned Freiflächensolaranlage units (92.7%) have no GenehmigungsMastrNummer/AktenzeichenGenehmigung, and only 134 list an EEG Zuschlagsnummer; 'In Planung' also retains projects already under construction until commissioning is reported.

Coordinate check across all 1,094 planned Freiflächensolaranlage units: 157 lack coordinates (154 <=30 kW under § 15 MaStRV plus 3 >30 kW with IsAnonymisiert=true: SEE921542231489, SEE931051684669, SEE998134823476); 0 of 937 geocoded units fall outside Germany, but 2 fall outside their declared Bundesland (SEE919089128768 declares Sachsen-Anhalt/Angern with placeholder lon 14.123456 in Brandenburg; SEE927229282546 declares Berlin HQ while coordinates 53.554356, 11.689993 lie in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern).

evidence.claim: Pre-commissioning registration in MaStR is possible in planning, design or construction phases by either the future operator or developer, but mandatory only when a federal-law permit (BImSchG, WindSeeG, WHG or other Bundesrecht) is required.
evidence.quote: Die Registrierung der geplanten Einheit kann vom künftigen Betreiber oder vom Projektierer durchgeführt werden. ... Eine gesetzliche Pflicht zur Registrierung geplanter Einheiten besteht nur, wenn für diese eine der folgenden Zulassungen benötigt wird: Zulassung nach dem Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz / Zulassung nach dem Windenergie-auf-See-Gesetz / Zulassung nach dem Wasserhaushaltsgesetz / Zulassung nach sonstigem Bundesrecht

evidence.claim: Daily bulk XML Gesamtdatenexport (3,311,214,446 bytes via HTTP HEAD/Range 206 on 2026-11-25) is published under Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0.
evidence.quote: Hier können Sie die gesamten öffentlichen Daten des Marktstammdatenregisters herunterladen. Die Daten werden im XML Format bereitgestellt.

sources.name: EEG-Ausschreibungen — Zuschlagslisten (Solaranlagen 1. Segment, 2. Segment & Innovationsausschreibungen)
sources.format: XLSX (one workbook per tender round per segment)
sources.license: Statutory publication under § 35(1) EEG 2023 (no explicit open-data license stated on page)
sources.adds: Publishes every subsidised solar PV bid awarded an EEG/InnAusV tariff per tender round, adding verified bidder name, awarded capacity in kW, cadastral parcel list (Gemarkung/Flurstück) and statutory award notice date, including projects not yet voluntarily registered in MaStR.
sources.summary: Official Bundesnetzagentur Excel award lists for EEG Solar Segment 1 (ground-mounted), Segment 2 (rooftop >1 MW) and Innovationsausschreibungen (solar+storage), naming every winning bid, kW volume, cadastral parcels and award date.
sources.coverage_note: Latest single-round files tested: 261 awarded ground-mounted bids in Segment 1 (01.07.2026), 143 rooftop bids in Segment 2 (01.10.2026), and 32 solar+storage bids in InnAusV (01.09.2026); earlier rounds are archived per bid date.
caveats: Covers only EEG/InnAusV tender winners; omits merchant/PPA solar parks and pre-tender projects.
Location is text Gemarkung/Flurstück without WGS84 coordinates (location_precision = municipality).
Static award-date snapshots; cross-check MaStR to exclude awards already commissioned.

coverage.geographic: Germany (all awarded bids in EEG Solar Segment 1, Segment 2 and InnAusV)

unit.value: Gebotsmenge in kW (DC installed capacity bid under § 3 Nr. 31 / § 37 EEG; divide by 1,000 for MWp).
unit.quote: Name des Bieters | Gebots-Nr | Zuschlags-Nr | Gebotsmenge | Angegebener Standort der Anlage | Bekanntgabe des Zuschlags

inclusion_rule.value: Covers bids winning an EEG/InnAusV award: Segment 1 covers ground-mounted and non-building PV up to 20 MW (up to 50 MW in special cases) that hold at least a published Bebauungsplan draft/Aufstellungsbeschluss + Offenlage or § 35 BauGB/plan-approval eligibility (§ 37 EEG); Segment 2 covers building/noise-barrier PV >1,000 kW; InnAusV covers solar-plus-storage combinations.
inclusion_rule.quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur gibt die Zuschläge mit den folgenden Angaben auf ihrer Internetseite bekannt: ... den Namen der Bieter, die einen Zuschlag erhalten haben, mit a) dem jeweils in dem Gebot angegebenen Standort der Anlage ... e) der jeweils bezuschlagten Gebotsmenge

reference_date.value: Latest tested rounds: Segment 1 bid date 2026-07-01 (award notice date 2026-08-25), Segment 2 bid date 2026-10-01 (award notice date 2026-11-10), and InnAusV bid date 2026-09-01 (award notice date 2026-10-06).
reference_date.quote: Zuschläge des Ausschreibungsverfahrens EEG Solar für den Gebotstermin 01.07.2026

update_frequency.value: Three tender rounds per year each for Segment 1 (1 March, 1 July, 1 December) and Segment 2 (1 February, 1 June, 1 October), plus two rounds per year for Innovationsausschreibungen (1 May, 1 September).
update_frequency.quote: Kompakte Darstellung: Pro Zeile wird ein Zuschlag dargestellt.

exclusions.value: Excludes subsidy-free (merchant/PPA) solar parks, installations <=1,000 kW outside tenders, unsuccessful/excluded bids, and individual bid prices (ct/kWh). Round award lists are eventually removed after statutory realisation deadlines expire.
exclusions.quote: Der Zuschlag ist eine Woche nach der öffentlichen Bekanntgabe nach Absatz 1 als bekanntgegeben anzusehen.

key_fields.meaning: Awarded bidder/project SPV or developer entity.
Unique award identifier (e.g. SOL26-2/235, SDA26-3/073, Inn26-2/002).
Awarded bid capacity in kW (present in sheet Zuschläge_Kompakt; omitted in sheet Zuschläge_Detailliert).

key_fields.field: Bundesland / Landkreis / Postleitzahl / Gemeinde / Gemarkung / Flur / Flurstück
key_fields.meaning: Structured administrative and cadastral parcel siting in sheet Zuschläge_Detailliert (no WGS84 coordinates).
Statutory effective date of award notice (Excel serial date, 1 week after web publication per § 35(2) EEG).

how_to_use.example_result: Row 5: Name des Bieters='1. Grünstrom PV UG (haftungsbeschränkt) & Co. KG', Zuschlags-Nr='SOL26-2/235', Gebotsmenge=2000 (kW), Angegebener Standort='Schleswig-Holstein, Landkreis Segeberg, PLZ 24649, Gemeinde Wiemersdorf, Gemarkung Wiemersdorf: Flur 6: 38; 40; 44; 46; 52; 55', Bekanntgabe=2026-08-25 (46259)
steps: Download the per-round Zuschlagsliste XLSX from BeendeteAusschreibungen under Solaranlagen1 (ground-mounted), Solaranlagen2 (rooftop >1 MW, e.g. ZuschlagslisteOkt2026.xlsx) and Innovation (solar+storage, e.g. ZuschlagslisteSep26.xlsx).

Read sheet Zuschläge_Kompakt (header row 4, data from row 5) for 1-row-per-award capacity (Gebotsmenge in kW; divide by 1,000 for MW) and convert the Excel serial integer in Bekanntgabe des Zuschlags from base date 1899-12-30.

Join on Zuschlags-Nr to sheet Zuschläge_Detailliert for split columns Bundesland, Landkreis, Postleitzahl, Gemeinde, Gemarkung and Flur / Flurstück, and (in InnAusV) to Zuschläge_Registernummern for MaStR EEG... IDs.
reading_traps: Sheet Zuschläge_Detailliert repeats multi-Gemarkung awards across multiple rows (296 rows for 261 awards in July 2026 Segment 1) and omits Gebotsmenge; always aggregate capacity from Zuschläge_Kompakt.

Bekanntgabe des Zuschlags is stored as an unformatted Excel serial integer (e.g. 46259 = 2026-08-25, 46336 = 2026-11-10, 46301 = 2026-10-06) representing the legal deemed-notice date 7 days after website publication under § 35(2) EEG.

Each round is a separate static XLSX snapshot that is not updated when a project later receives its Baugenehmigung, enters construction, is commissioned (check MaStR Zuschlagsnummern to filter out already-commissioned awards), or forfeits its bid bond.

evidence.claim: Segment 1 July 2026 XLSX contains 261 compact award rows (and 296 detailed parcel rows) with bidder, Zuschlags-Nr, Gebotsmenge in kW, parcel list and award date.
evidence.quote: Zuschläge des Ausschreibungsverfahrens EEG Solar für den Gebotstermin 01.07.2026 | Kompakte Darstellung: Pro Zeile wird ein Zuschlag dargestellt.

evidence.claim: Segment 2 October 2026 XLSX (ZuschlagslisteOkt2026.xlsx, 32,331 bytes) adds 143 building/noise-barrier solar awards, and InnAusV September 2026 XLSX (ZuschlagslisteSep26.xlsx, 19,245 bytes) adds 32 solar+storage awards linked to 64 MaStR EEG IDs.

sources.name: Zentrale Landesportale der Bauleitplanung (16 Bundesländer & DiPlanung-Portal)

sources.license: Varies by Land/municipality (mostly public inspection only; open geodata subsets under dl-de/by-2-0 or dl-de/zero-2-0)
sources.adds: Provides statutory access under §§ 3(2), 4a and 10a BauGB to municipal Bebauungspläne for non-privileged ground-mounted solar PV parks ('Sondergebiet Photovoltaik'), exposing exact planning stages (Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegung, Satzungsbeschluss), decision dates and PDF Begründungen.
sources.summary: Statutory state urban land-use planning portals (§§ 3(2), 10a BauGB) across all 16 Bundesländer (partly federated at portal.diplanung.de), providing access to municipal Bebauungspläne for ground-mounted solar parks.
sources.coverage_note: 16 of 16 state portals checked on 2026-11-25; records are general municipal planning procedures (no solar-only structured count) linking to ~11,000 municipalities' draft and adopted PDF plan packages.
caveats: Web viewers and municipal link directories only; no downloadable structured list of solar PV projects or MW capacities.
Covers non-privileged ground-mounted PV requiring a Bebauungsplan; excludes § 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB corridor permits and rooftop PV.
Tracks zoning up to Satzungsbeschluss, not subsequent county Baugenehmigung or construction start.

coverage.geographic: Germany (all 16 Bundesländer via state portals, indexing participating municipalities among ~11,000 Gemeinden)

unit.value: Plan documents state Geltungsbereich / Sondergebiet area in ha; electrical capacity (MWp DC, inverter MW AC, grid connection MW) appears only in narrative PDF Begründungen when reported by the developer.
unit.quote: Das Plangebiet weist eine Größe von ca. 223 ha auf. Eine Netzreservierung von 268 MWp wurde gesichert.

inclusion_rule.value: Non-privileged outdoor ground-mounted PV parks require a municipal Bebauungsplan (often vorhabenbezogener Bebauungsplan under § 12 BauGB); drafts in public consultation (§ 3(2) BauGB) and adopted plans (§ 10a(2) BauGB) are published online and made accessible via each Land's central portal.
inclusion_rule.quote: Der in Kraft getretene Bebauungsplan mit der Begründung und der zusammenfassenden Erklärung soll ergänzend auch in das Internet eingestellt und über ein zentrales Internetportal des Landes zugänglich gemacht werden.

reference_date.value: Continuously updated by municipalities during statutory participation windows and upon plan adoption (checked across all 16 Länder portals on 2026-11-25).
reference_date.quote: Das Zentrale Landesportal für Raumordnungs- und Bauleitplanung Sachsen bietet einen Überblick über alle aktuellen Planverfahren im Freistaat Sachsen.

update_frequency.value: Event-driven per municipal procedure (upon Aufstellungsbeschluss, § 3(1) early participation, § 3(2) public display, and § 10(3) Satzungsbeschluss notice).
update_frequency.quote: Unter „Pläne in Aufstellung“ finden Sie die noch nicht beschlossenen Entwürfe von Bauleitplänen, die sich noch im laufenden Aufstellungsverfahren befinden.

exclusions.value: Excludes rooftop PV and privileged outdoor PV (e.g. within 200 m of motorways or double-track railways under § 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB) that proceed directly to county Baugenehmigung without a Bebauungsplan; does not track subsequent Baugenehmigung or construction status; many portals remove draft PDFs once the participation deadline closes.
exclusions.quote: Der Zeitraum für das Beteiligungsverfahren liegt in der Vergangenheit. Es ist nicht mehr möglich, sich daran zu beteiligen.

key_fields.meaning: Title of the Bebauungsplan or FNP amendment (search 'Photovoltaik', 'Solarpark', 'Freiflächen-PV', 'Sondergebiet Solar').
Planning phase: Aufstellungsbeschluss, Frühzeitige Beteiligung (§ 3(1) BauGB), Öffentliche Auslegung (§ 3(2) BauGB), or Satzungsbeschluss / Rechtskraft (§ 10 BauGB).
Consultation window dates on the portal and exact council decision dates inside the Bekanntmachung and Begründung PDFs.

how_to_use.example_request: Open https://portal.diplanung.de/ (BY, BE, BB, HB, HH, NI, SH federated search) or state portals such as https://buergerbeteiligung.sachsen.de/portal/bplan/startseite and filter plan titles by 'Photovoltaik' or 'Solarpark'.
how_to_use.example_result: Portal lists general urban land-use plans (no solar-only structured table) and links out to municipal pages and PDF plan packages (Bekanntmachung, Planzeichnung, Begründung, Umweltbericht, Zusammenfassende Erklärung).
steps: Query the target Land's central Bauleitplanungsportal (or https://portal.diplanung.de/ for connected Länder) for keywords 'Photovoltaik', 'Solarpark' or 'Sondergebiet' and filter to active participation ('im Verfahren' / 'Pläne in Aufstellung').
Follow the link to the municipal procedure page and download the Bekanntmachung and Begründung PDFs.

Extract the council decision date (Aufstellungsbeschluss, Auslegungsbeschluss or Satzungsbeschluss), Vorhabenträger, Gemarkung/Flurstücke and any stated MWp/MW/grid-connection figures from the Begründung.
reading_traps: None of the 16 Länder portals provides a downloadable state-wide structured table filtered to solar PV projects; solar parks are mixed with housing and commercial Bebauungspläne and cannot be filtered by MW.

Several Länder portals (e.g. Brandenburg and Niedersachsen on UVP-Verbund, Sachsen-Anhalt LVwA) act only as link directories to municipal websites, where past participation documents often disappear between § 3(2) Auslegung and § 10a Rechtskraft.
A rechtskräftiger Bebauungsplan (Satzungsbeschluss) creates municipal zoning right, not the building permit (Baugenehmigung) itself.

problems: No unified national/state structured download of solar PV permitting records; portals serve interactive SPA maps or municipal link directories.

evidence.claim: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's central portal separates adopted plans from plans currently in preparation ('Pläne in Aufstellung').
evidence.quote: Unter „Pläne in Aufstellung“ finden Sie die noch nicht beschlossenen Entwürfe von Bauleitplänen, die sich noch im laufenden Aufstellungsverfahren befinden.

evidence.claim: Sachsen's central Bauleitplanung portal aggregates ongoing municipal planning procedures with status and participation dates.

regulator.name: Bundesnetzagentur (BNetzA) — federal energy registry & EEG tenders; ~11,000 Gemeinden (Bauleitplanung) and ~400 untere Bauaufsichtsbehörden (Baugenehmigung)

operators.note: Thousands of project SPVs (GmbH & Co. KG), utilities, energy cooperatives and commercial/private rooftop owners develop solar PV plants; registered market actors (Marktakteure, prefix ABR...) are listed in MaStR except natural persons.

publication_obligation.norm: § 5 & § 15 MaStRV (post-commissioning solar registration; federal-law permits only pre-commissioning); § 35 EEG 2023 (BNetzA tender awards); §§ 3(2), 4a & 10a BauGB (online municipal Bauleitplanung via central Länder portals)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: BNetzA must publish EEG tender winners, bid kW, parcel siting and award dates (§ 35 EEG), and public MaStR unit data (>30 kW with coordinates; voluntary pre-commissioning for solar PV under § 5(4) MaStRV). Municipalities must publish draft Bebauungspläne during consultation (§ 3(2) BauGB) and adopted plans (§ 10a BauGB) online and via central state portals; county Baugenehmigungen have no public publication obligation.
publication_obligation.frequency: Continuous in MaStR (daily XML export at 05:00); after each of 3+3+2 annual EEG/InnAusV tender rounds; event-driven per municipal Bauleitplan step.

consolidated_republication.note: BNetzA consolidates voluntary pre-commissioning MaStR registrations and EEG tender winners nationwide, while DiPlanung (7+ Länder) and UVP-Verbund (7 Länder for solar) partially federate municipal Bauleitplanung links; no authority consolidates all municipal PV Bebauungspläne or county Baugenehmigungen into one structured dataset.

checked_pages.saw: Daily nationwide XML Gesamtdatenexport and live JSON API include 63,257 'In Planung' solar units, but pre-commissioning solar registration is voluntary under § 5(4) MaStRV and lacks permitting sub-stages.
Publishes per-round XLSX Zuschlagslisten for awarded EEG bids only, without coordinates or post-award permitting/construction updates.
Cross-state SPA viewer federating spatial plans/consultations for participating Länder, without a solar-specific filter or bulk project table.
Policy dossier and aggregate expansion monitoring; no project-level solar PV permitting inventory.

national_registry.note: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) is the official single national energy register and includes an 'In Planung' status (63,257 solar PV units on 2026-11-25), but under § 5(4) MaStRV pre-commissioning registration is legally mandatory only for units requiring a federal-law permit (not state-law Baugenehmigungen or municipal Bebauungspläne), and MaStR does not distinguish planning, permitting, authorised or construction stages.

checked_pages.saw: Confirms planned units must be registered only when requiring a permit under BImSchG, WindSeeG, WHG or other federal law; standard solar PV registration in 'In Planung' is voluntary until commissioning.
Explicitly states that wind and PV installations are included only aggregated by Bundesland and operational status, not as individual plants.
Covers EEG policy and aggregate renewable targets; no national solar permitting register.

Contains 127 German 'Photovoltaik' entries (115 municipal Bauleitplanung link cards and 12 UVP/screening cases), confirming standard solar parks are not centrally tracked in a federal EIA permit database.

if_unstructured.summary: Because MaStR 'In Planung' is voluntary and merges all pre-commissioning phases while BNetzA lists only EEG tender winners, exact permitting stages (Aufstellungsbeschluss, § 3(2) Auslegung, § 10 Satzungsbeschluss), council decision dates, Vorhabenträger and grid-reservation MWp for non-privileged ground-mounted solar parks must be extracted from municipal Bebauungsplan PDFs via the 16 Länder Bauleitplanung portals and municipal websites.
recipe: Start from MaStR (Betriebs-Status = 'In Planung', Art der Solaranlage = 'Freiflächensolaranlage', 1,094 units) and BNetzA EEG Segment 1/InnAusV Zuschlagslisten XLSX files, deduplicating on MaStR EEG numbers, Zuschlags-Nr, or Municipality + Gemarkung + Flurstück.

For target Länder or municipalities, query the Land's central Bauleitplanungsportal (and portal.diplanung.de / uvp-verbund.de) for 'Photovoltaik' or 'Solarpark' to capture projects in Aufstellungsbeschluss or § 3(2) Auslegung that have not yet bid in EEG tenders or registered in MaStR.

Download the Bekanntmachung, Begründung and (if already adopted) Zusammenfassende Erklärung PDFs; extract text with pdftotext (converting scanned Bekanntmachungen such as Mötzing's 09-bekanntmachung-satzung.pdf via pdftoppm/OCR if needed).

Record from Section 'Verfahren / Rechtsverhältnisse' the latest procedural milestone (Aufstellungsbeschluss, Frühzeitige Beteiligung, Öffentliche Auslegung, or Satzungsbeschluss) and its council session date — never the website upload date.

Record from Section 'Lage und Größe / Technische Planung' the Geltungsbereich/Sondergebiet area (ha) and, where stated, DC module peak (MWp), inverter AC power (MW) and grid reservation/connection capacity, plus the Vorhabenträger from the cover sheet or Vorhaben- und Erschließungsplan.
if_unstructured.location_method: Bebauungsplan Begründungen, Bekanntmachungen and BNetzA EEG award tables list Gemeinde, Gemarkung, Flur and Flurstück numbers; intersect those parcel identifiers with official state ALKIS cadastral WFS/WMS services (via Geoportal.de or state geoportals) or digitize the Geltungsbereich boundary from the Planzeichnung PDF.
if_unstructured.cross_with: Cross-check municipal Bebauungspläne with MaStR ('In Betrieb' status = 35 as well as 'In Planung' = 31) to remove solar parks that have already been commissioned, and with BNetzA EEG Segment 1 / InnAusV Zuschlagslisten on Gemarkung + Flurstück to attach awarded kW capacities and bidder SPVs.

open_questions: No public source quantifies what share of Germany's uncommissioned ground-mounted PV pipeline is voluntarily registered early in MaStR ('In Planung') versus first appearing after commissioning under § 5(1) MaStRV.

Privileged ground-mounted solar PV projects within 200 m of motorways or double-track railways (§ 35(1) Nr. 8b BauGB) require only a county-level Baugenehmigung without a municipal Bebauungsplan; unless they win an EEG tender or voluntarily register in MaStR, whether any Land plans to publish county Baugenehmigung statistics/lists remains undocumented.

local_terms.meaning: Ground-mounted solar PV installation (MaStR Art der Solaranlage code 852).
MaStR pre-commissioning unit status (code 31), covering voluntary entries from early planning through active construction.
Project-specific municipal binding land-use plan (§ 12 BauGB, § 11 BauNVO) creating zoning right for non-privileged solar parks.
Sequential municipal Bauleitplanung milestones: initiation (§ 2(1) BauGB), draft public consultation (§ 3(2) BauGB) and statutory adoption (§ 10 BauGB).
State-law construction permit issued by the county/city Bauaufsichtsbehörde (required after Satzungsbeschluss or directly for privileged § 35 BauGB corridor PV).
